title: Site configuration
description: content/config.json: identity, links, feature flags, labels and theme for the site. Only name is required; everything else has a default.

$schema.description: Optional path or URL of this schema, for editors other than VS Code.

name.description: Your full name. Shown in the hero, page titles and metadata; publication authors matching its first and last word are highlighted.

initials.description: Monogram in the navbar. Defaults to the first letter of each word of name.

title.description: Job title, e.g. "PhD Student in Computer Science". Used in the default homepage title and as the JSON-LD jobTitle.

homepageTitle.description: Browser title of the homepage. Defaults to "<name> — <title>".

bio.description: One-paragraph third-person bio used as the default meta description and JSON-LD description.

intro.description: Hero text under your name on the homepage. Markdown is supported.

image.description: Profile photo, a path under public/ starting with "/" (rendered with next/image). Defaults to /images/placeholder.png.

favicon.description: Favicon URL or path under public/. Defaults to /images/favicon.ico.

knowsAbout.description: Research areas for the JSON-LD Person profile (search engines).

authorAliases.description: Other spellings of your name in author lists (e.g. "J. Doe"). Must match an author string exactly (case-insensitive) to be highlighted.

siteUrl.description: Absolute URL of the deployed site, without a trailing slash, e.g. "https://janedoe.example.com". Used for canonical URLs, the sitemap, RSS and llms.txt. Falls back to resume_contact.website_url.

email.description: Contact email: the /contact form sends to it and the chatbot quotes it.

contactText.description: Paragraph on /contact. Only **bold** is supported (no links). Defaults to a sentence with email.

contactEmails.description: Not displayed by the site (written by npm run setup). Put addresses in contactText instead.

footerText.description: Small print at the bottom of every page.

footerLinks.description: Footer links: label -> URL, e.g. {"Google Scholar": "https://...", "GitHub": "https://..."}. All are listed in llms.txt; those whose label does not contain "source" also become JSON-LD sameAs profiles.

additionalProperties.description: URL (absolute, or a path under public/ such as /assets/slides.pdf).

resume.description: Full CV PDF, as a path under public/ (e.g. "/Jane_Doe_CV.pdf"). Adds a download button in the hero; scripts/generate_resumes.py writes the PDF to this path.

resume_short.description: Short resume PDF path under public/ (e.g. "/Jane_Doe_Resume.pdf"). Adds a second hero button; generated like resume.

resume_contact.description: Contact line of the generated resumes. Also used for the llms.txt links.

website_url.description: Full website URL. Defaults to https://<website>; also the fallback for siteUrl.

github.description: GitHub profile without https:// (e.g. "github.com/janedoe"); https:// is added automatically.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn profile without https:// (e.g. "linkedin.com/in/janedoe"); https:// is added automatically.

publicationCategories.description: Main research areas: the category nodes of the topic graph. Each should also appear in the tags of your publications. Defaults to the 3 most frequent tags.

categoryDescriptions.description: Text shown when hovering a category node: category name (from publicationCategories) -> sentence.

blogDescription.description: Meta description of /blogs and the RSS feed. Defaults to "Posts by <name>."

features.description: Turn site sections on or off. Omitted keys use their default.

about.description: About page (/about) from content/about.md. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

publications.description: Publications on the homepage and /publications, plus the navbar search. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

researchGraph.description: Interactive topic graph on /publications (built from publication tags and publicationCategories). Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

projects.description: Projects section on the homepage and /projects. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

experience.description: Experience section on the homepage and /work-experiences (work-experience.json); research and teaching experience in llms-full.txt and the chatbot. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

education.description: Education section on the homepage. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

blogs.description: Blog at /blogs from content/blogs/*.md, plus /rss.xml. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

news.description: News list on the homepage. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

talks.description: Talks & Presentations list on the homepage. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

services.description: Academic Services section on the homepage. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

skills.description: Skills section on the homepage. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

awards.description: Awards section on the homepage. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

contact.description: Contact page (/contact) with a mailto form. Default: true. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

games.description: Games menu and /games/* pages (cricket, hangman, tic-tac-toe). Default: false. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

chatbot.description: Floating AI chatbot and /api/chat. Needs the NVIDIA_API_KEY environment variable. Default: false. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

linktree.description: Link-in-bio pages at /linktree and /linktree/<path> (linktree.json). Default: false. Disabled sections disappear from the navigation, their pages return 404 and they leave the sitemap.

workExperience.description: Deprecated: use experience. Still honoured when experience is not set.

enableChatbot.description: Deprecated: use features.chatbot. Still honoured when features.chatbot is not set.

botName.description: Chatbot name in its greeting. Defaults to "<first name>AI".

chatbot.description: Chatbot settings (only used when features.chatbot is on).

model.description: NVIDIA NIM model id used by /api/chat.

availability.description: Your current availability (e.g. "Open to summer 2026 internships"), given to the bot as context.

labels.description: Override UI text. Omitted keys keep their default.

experienceTitle.description: Heading of the experience section and page.

contactIntro.default: Hello there! Whether it's about research, collaboration, or just an idea you'd like to share, don't hesitate to reach out!

skillCategories.description: Display names for skills.json keys, e.g. {"ml-and-data": "ML & Data"}. Keys without an entry are title-cased.

theme.description: Colours and heading font. With no colours set the site keeps Bootstrap's default palette.

headingFont.description: Google Fonts family for headings, e.g. "Space Grotesk".

accentColor.description: Hex colour for links and primary buttons, e.g. "#2f6fed".

gradientStart.description: Hex colour: start of the gradient on your name in the hero (needs gradientEnd).

gradientEnd.description: Hex colour: end of the name gradient; also the link hover colour when accentColor is set.
